findings.title: Verify fast-uri 4.1.2 registry integrity hash
findings.description: The lock files record sha512-TyGmBcbDTZXcb2cj5MV89DrF42DKvb3y5DDUNh95iO+IMeAzMkVSxK1PZRrRIpc9yg8U2GhGdbofNa0LS/a4Bw== for fast-uri@4.1.2. For a CVE-motivated upgrade it is worth confirming this hash matches the tarball published on the npm registry rather than a tampered or mis-cached version.
findings.cause: bun computes and stores the integrity hash during `bun install`; if the install ran against a poisoned local cache or a mirror that served a modified tarball, the wrong hash could be committed.
findings.fix: Run `npm view fast-uri@4.1.2 dist.integrity` (or check registry.npmjs.org) and confirm the sha512 value matches both lock files. The hash is identical in bun.lock:672 and apps/site/bun.lock:524, which rules out a per-workspace discrepancy but does not confirm registry authenticity.
